newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- St. Mary's College of Maryland.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- St. Mary's College of Maryland.

text.p: Academic Fees and Auxiliary Facility Fees Revenue Bonds
Notice is hereby given that sealed bids will be received by St. Mary's College of Maryland at the offices of Gallagher, Evelius & Jones, Suite 400, 218 North Charles St., Baltimore, Maryland 21201 on
until 11:00 a.m. Baltimore time for the purchase of

$10,000,000* principal amount of St. Mary's College of Maryland Academic Fees and Auxiliary Facilities Fees Revenue Bonds, 1997 Series A (the Bonds''). The Bonds offered for sale will be dated as of July 1, 1997 and will mature or have sinking fund redemptions on September 1 in the years 1999 through 2027, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase all of the Bonds at the lowest interest cost, calculated in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check or surety bond in the amount of $100,000 payable to St. Mary's College of Maryland or naming it as the beneficiary, in the case of a surety bond. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Official Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from Public Financial Management, Inc., financial advisor to St. Mary's College of Maryland, at 99 Summer Street, Suite 1020, Boston, Massachusetts 02110 (617) 330-6914 or Karen House at St. Mary's College of Maryland, Business Office, St. Mary's City, Maryland 20686 (301) 862-0305. *Preliminary, subject to change.
Dr. Steven Muller, Chairman of the Board of Trustees Dated: June 25, 1997
